summary: Daytona includes $200 in free compute with its free trial, with no credit card required. Daytona's billing documentation says free-credit balances are not available for GPU sandboxes. The submitted 5 GiB free-storage claim was omitted because neither official source currently states it.
claim_steps: Open Daytona pricing and choose the free trial.
Create a Daytona account; the official page says no credit card is required.
Use the $200 free compute balance on eligible non-GPU sandboxes.

social_proof.title: Daytona Pricing
social_proof.text: Use what you need, when you need it. $200 in free compute included. Sign up for a free trial — no credit card required.

social_proof.title: Billing | Daytona
social_proof.text: Free credit balance: the amount of free credits; not available for GPU sandboxes. Daytona consumes free credits before paid credits.
